MMHotline-down alarm

Checking in

MMHotline last checked in just now.

If MMHotline goes quiet, the MMHotline-down alarm wakes nobody: nobody on call gets SOS alerts by Pushover or automated voice call.

Test the alarm

THE PHONE MAY SOUND ONCE MORE. THERE IS NOTHING TO DO.

Each person above gets a test alert now. For a Pushover notification, MMHotline checks Pushover's receipt and cancels the repeats.
Where the MMHotline-down alarm is set up

Set in TEMPORARY-DIRECTORY/mmhotline_settings.yml, in mmhotline_down_alarm. The file's first line says: Managed by MMX from mmhotline_settings.yml in the systems repository. Change it there and push; util01 applies it.
